The Ads Agent completed the work, but its callback did not reach Command Center. Contract Manufacturing improved to a 17.3% CTR, while Haircare is the current watch item at the last verified ad-group pull; its sample is still too small to call definitively wasteful. Attribution remains too thin for a budget increase: 12 unique leads, only 1 verified Ads-attributed lead, and 3 booked calls with none paid-attributed. Keep both new campaigns within the existing $30 daily / $210 weekly cap and make no budget change yet. This recommendation requires no campaign-spend approval because no Ads settings are being changed.
